basic_profile.bio: Living in Austin, TX, I'm a 34-year-old software engineer with a passion for decentralized finance and a mild obsession with physics. I spend my days coding and my evenings exploring new game strategies. Not a fan of overly simplistic explanations, I enjoy diving deep into topics. Typically online during late evenings. Married with no kids, I enjoy a quiet life with my partner and our two cats.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: Holds a degree in Computer Science from the University of Texas. Developed a keen interest in blockchain and cryptocurrency, leading to self-taught expertise in decentralized finance. Additionally, a long-time physics enthusiast with a penchant for online courses and lectures.
